gate_text: G1: pre-execution grounding verified live - IsPETase ACT_SITE (S160/D206/H237) + PF12740 xref retrieved live, hmmscan-vs-pfam route validated end-to-end (met at lock time, evidence in grounding_evidence_pre_lock); provenance route validated on >=5 samples before bulk run
G2: hmmscan annotation succeeds for >= 90% of the 468 candidates (coverage floor; failures enumerated)
G3: >= 60% of annotated candidates have PF12740 as best-E domain (domain coherence)
G4: >= 200 candidates have the intact catalytic triad S-D-H at IsPETase-aligned positions
G5: >= 150 candidates resolve to >= 1 MGnify study/biome; biome distribution reported
G6: redundancy clustering reported; anti-panel flag rate reported and < 20%

G7: shortlist of exactly 20 delivered; every shortlisted candidate has triad intact, PF12740 coherence, not anti-panel flagged, and (RCSB template E<=1e-10 with >=60% coverage OR a documented exception); >= 10 of 20 at <40% identity to every reference
note: G4 locked threshold 200 not met (45/468 intact) - preserved negative, see report
